title: Terrigenous Deposits
definition: Terrigenous deposits are sediments derived from the land (lithogenous origin) that are transported to the oceans via rivers, winds, glaciers, and coastal erosion, constituting the bulk of continental margin sediments.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims under Geomorphology and Oceanography (marine sediments, pelagic vs. neritic deposits) and in Mains GS-1 regarding ocean topography and resource geography.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Terrigenous Deposits.
Evaluate spatial distribution, transport mechanisms, and sediment classification.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
